# Ryzova UCE — Universal Compatibility Engine

> Ryzova UCE (Universal Compatibility Engine) is an open-source software compatibility analyzer from Ryzova for ZIP projects and public GitHub repositories.

Ryzova UCE is the official Universal Compatibility Engine from Ryzova. Its canonical website is https://uce.ryzova.com/ and its official source repository is https://github.com/RyzovaTech/Ryzova-UCE-Original. It uses deterministic, browser-based checks rather than AI-generated analysis.
UCE V3 includes 3,000 validated core rules with unique IDs, confidence labels, bounded execution, evidence, recommendations, and false-positive guidance.

## Product
UCE analyzes project structure, runtimes, dependencies, configuration, and compatibility risks in the browser.

## Detection Coverage
- 3,000 validated V3 core rules across 14 built-in packs
- 77 programming and source-language labels, including TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Java, Go, Rust, C++, C#, Kotlin, Swift, PHP, Ruby, HTML, CSS, SQL, GraphQL, Bash and PowerShell
- 639 technology detection definitions consolidated into 524 unique named technology profiles
- 43 framework definitions, including React, Next.js, Vue, Angular, SvelteKit, Express, NestJS, Django, Flask, FastAPI, Spring Boot, Laravel, Rails and Flutter
- 37 runtime definitions, including Node.js, Bun, Deno, Python, JVM, Go, Rust, Ruby, BEAM, Dart, Swift and .NET
- 76 database definitions, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite, MongoDB, Redis, DynamoDB, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Supabase, CockroachDB and Neo4j
- 78 build-tool definitions, including Vite, Webpack, Rollup, esbuild, Maven, Gradle, Cargo, CMake, Bazel, Xcode and Make
- 40 package-manager definitions, including npm, pnpm, Yarn, Bun, pip, Poetry, Cargo, Maven, Gradle, Composer, NuGet and CocoaPods
- 150 library definitions, including React Native, Expo, Redux, Zustand, Axios, PyTorch, TensorFlow, NumPy and Pandas
- 94 testing-tool definitions, including Vitest, Jest and Playwright
- 13 linting-tool definitions, 11 styling-tool definitions, 10 authentication definitions, 19 ORM definitions, 26 CI/CD definitions, 41 cloud/platform definitions, and 1 container definition
- 105 browser compatibility feature rules
- 40 security checks across 13 categories
- 22 evidence-based architecture patterns
- 21 project intelligence capabilities

## Features
- Analyze ZIP project archives locally
- Analyze public GitHub repositories
- Detect languages, frameworks, runtimes, package managers, and build tools
- Flag compatibility issues with deterministic rules
- Generate compatibility reports
- Keep project analysis local in the browser
